help: Adds experience to an officer, or to all officers with "all". Experience past an officer's level cap is banked as their mastery experience. Without an amount (or with "levelup") adds enough for the next level; a negative amount removes mastery experience. Run without arguments to list your officers with their numbers, experience and mastery experience.
Adds the amount to the global mastery experience pool (a negative amount removes it). Run without arguments to show the pool.
